name: – Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga – Article 2, after § 8 – Am 340
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 8a. Support provided under this Regulation shall not confer on the Commission or on the ERCC any power to direct national authorities, to determine national civil protection or health policy, or to order the deployment of national personnel, equipment or other assets. Assistance on the territory of a Member State shall require a request by that Member State and its express consent to the scope and practical arrangements of that assistance. The requesting Member State shall retain overall direction of operations on its territory. The assisting Member State shall retain command of its personnel and the right to withdraw its assistance.
